## Berlin Short-Term Rental Search Plan

Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/house.svg

For a 2-month stay in Berlin, the best results usually come from furnished apartments, serviced apartments, and verified sublets. With a **€1,800/month cap**, your strongest fit is typically in outer-center neighborhoods with U-Bahn/S-Bahn access rather than the most central zones.

## Search Filters and Listing Rubric

| Filter / Criterion | Recommended Setting | Why it matters |
|---|---|---|
| Stay dates | 2026-07-01 to 2026-08-31 | Locks inventory to your exact 2-month window |
| Occupancy | 2 adults | Avoids unsuitable studio-only or single-occupant listings |
| Unit type | 1 bedroom / 1+ room | Gives enough privacy and work space |
| Furnishing | Furnished | Essential for short-term move-in |
| Laundry | Washing machine in unit preferred | Reduces weekly hassle and extra cost |
| Internet | “Reliable Wi‑Fi” or “high-speed internet” | Critical for work and daily use |
| Transit | Under 35 min to Alexanderplatz | Keeps commute practical |
| Budget | Max €1,800/month all-in | Helps filter out overpriced tourist inventory |
| Lease length | 2 months, flexible extension optional | Improves availability for short stays |

### Search strategy by neighborhood
- Prioritize areas with direct or near-direct transit to Alexanderplatz: **Friedrichshain, Prenzlauer Berg, Mitte edge, Neukölln near Ringbahn, Wedding near U/S-Bahn, Lichtenberg, Treptow, Charlottenburg near S-Bahn**.
- Search both **apartment platforms** and **sublet/medium-stay platforms** because many Berlin listings are split across them.
- Use commute-first filtering: first confirm transit time, then confirm furnishing, then verify laundry/internet, then compare price.
- Expect the best value to come from listings slightly outside the center but on a strong line to Alexanderplatz.

## Listing Comparison Rubric

Use this scoring model to compare options consistently:

| Category | Weight | What to check | Good sign |
|---|---:|---|---|
| Commute to Alexanderplatz | 30% | Transit time door-to-door | **≤ 35 min** with 1 easy transfer or direct line |
| Total monthly cost | 25% | Rent, utilities, internet, fees, cleaning | At or below **€1,800 all-in** |
| Furnishing quality | 15% | Bed, desk, storage, kitchen basics | Fully move-in ready |
| Internet reliability | 15% | Speed, provider, tenant reviews, router included | Clear speed mention or positive reviews |
| Laundry convenience | 10% | In-unit washer vs shared laundry | In-unit washer preferred |
| Listing trust / lease clarity | 5% | Contract terms, deposit, cancellation, landlord verification | Clear terms, no vague conditions |

### Score each listing out of 100
- **90–100**: Excellent fit, shortlist immediately
- **75–89**: Good fit, worth viewing or messaging
- **60–74**: Acceptable only if trade-offs are minor
- **Below 60**: Skip unless supply is very limited

### Red flags to reject quickly
- No exact address or vague neighborhood only
- “Wi‑Fi available” without speed or router details
- Shared apartment with unclear room boundaries
- Extra charges not stated upfront
- Deposit unusually high for a short stay
- Commute depends on multiple slow transfers
- Photos show minimal furniture despite “furnished” claim
